newsitem.title: FINLAND: LAROX, RAUTE RISE ON BIG ORDERS.
newsitem.headline: LAROX, RAUTE RISE ON BIG ORDERS.

text.p: Shares in industrial filters maker Larox Oy and engineering group Raute Oy rose sharply on Wednesday after the companies said they had won big orders, brokers said.
At 1545/1245 GMT, Larox traded at 63 markka, up five or over 8.6 percent, in very active 22 million markka volume.
Raute traded at 52 markka, up three or 6.1 percent, in lively 13 million markka turnover.
"It must be the orders that are boosting the shares," one broker said.
Larox said it won orders for pressure filters from several international mining customers worth a total of 70 million markka. In 1996, Larox's net sales were 233 million markka.

Raute said its Precision unit had won orders worth 80 million markka for two glass plants' raw material systems, one in Brazil and one in the United States. Last year, Raute's consolidated net sales were some 750 million markka and the Precision unit's net sales were 194 million markka.
